text:
The purity of the body is the purity of the body consciousness.
The purity of the body consciousness is the purity of the seer.
Thus, the purity of the seer and the purity of the body consciousness are not two, nor are they divided.
The purity of the seer is the purity of the body consciousness.
The purity of the body consciousness is the purity of the seer.
Thus, the purity of the seer and the purity of the body consciousness are not two, nor are they divided.
The body’s purity is not two, not divided, not to be divided, not separate, and not different.
